notesStmt.note: Whitman appears to have written some of the material on this leaf in 1886 and some of it later, perhaps after the publication of November Boughs in 1888.

This manuscript contains several different draft title pages for a contemplated collection of material to be composed, seemingly, of poetry and prose that Whitman had written since the publication of Specimen Days & Collect in 1882. The most obvious manifestation of that idea is November Boughs (1888). The present manuscript bears indications (especially in his note at the top that refers specifically to November Boughs) that Whitman might have continued to entertain ideas for publishing another "annex" or "supplement" to Leaves of Grass under one of the titles here.
